summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Pearson plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting a PDMR (Person Discharging Managerial Responsibilities) share transaction under the company's U.S. Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The filing discloses that Tom ap Simon, President of Higher Education and Virtual Learning, purchased 515.2426 ADRs at $11.645 per ADR on July 14, 2026. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is present. This is a standard compensatory equity transaction, not a special situation.
